verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the agent writes tests and can safely run code/install dependencies/test changes in isolated sandboxes (codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-5), and PR review flow explicitly checks test coverage before posting results (codegen-docs-20), supporting self-validation before proposing changes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an iterative self-correction loop (agent re-running failed tests and fixing code before opening a PR) and independent/hands-on confirmation that generated tests actually catch regressions.
